name: Wainscot Prep
intent: Sand prep, fill fasteners, sand fill, caulk panel joints, caulk perimeter.
doctrine: Universal SF prep keepers. Caulking joints (substrate-specific LF math) is the slowest step — gated to SS_BARE + SS_PRIMED_FACTORY since field-primed wainscot was already caulked in the prior prime round. SEAL_MDF retired 2026-05-06.
